metadata.title: Open-Source AI Agent Skills and MCP Servers Supply-Chain Security Audit Dataset (105,000+ Indexed Skills, 2026)
metadata.description: Supply-chain security audit dataset covering 105,000+ open-source AI agent skills, Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers, and Codex skills, plus deep 5-dimension security reviews of 2,300+ repositories. Finds that 97.8% of open-source agent skills have never been security-audited, and 5.6% of audited skills trigger warnings or rejections for credential harvesting or unsafe command execution. Documented at https://jasonzhu.ai/en/blog/agent-skill-security-audit-200 and https://agentskillshub.top.
